name: Ikinari Hatsujou Switch to Lolicon
original_name: いきなり発情スイッチとロリコン
source:
You have purchased an "Estrus Switch" from a suspicious online shop.
It arrives and you try it out on your loli loli niece... It works and she wants you...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ198637.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
